protocol.interpretation: Target models use exact target empirical geometry: post-hoc oracle diagnostic, not independent prediction

original_protocol.calibration: Official train labels, source projection and shifted empirical geometry; oracle offline calibration
original_protocol.evaluation: Official test weighted empirical risk; fresh iid mixture draws with replacement from that finite pool
original_protocol.translation: Input score z+delta, original frozen threshold 0; centered initialization x0=-delta
original_protocol.translation_grid: delta=-q+offset*seed_sd/sqrt(n) when calibration has one unstable peak; otherwise delta=offset/sqrt(n) in source-standardized units, with prediction unavailable
original_protocol.la: Add tau*log prior to logits for entropy only; raw logits for evaluation. Estimated prior uses sqrt raw-argmax counts and EMA; oracle_la uses the imposed true prior.
original_protocol.transfer: Fixed-slope prediction applied to other modes as an assumption stress test
original_protocol.censoring: times=-1 retained in CDF denominator; invalid paths separately reported
original_protocol.risk_uncertainty: Classwise DKW bands require iid class samples; empirical risk itself is evaluated exactly
original_protocol.event: First t>=1 risk > frozen risk + epsilon; all modes start from the same frozen model
original_protocol.conjugacy: Numerical inverse interpolation; residual diagnostic, no exact numerical guarantee

protocol.empirical_quantile_note: Observed quantiles use total integer exit counts, avoiding floating ties from summing directional CDFs. Original results JSON is retained unchanged.
